entries.name: Divine Strength
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your Strength by $s1%.

entries.name: Divine Intellect
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your total Intellect by $s1%.

entries.name: Healing Light
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the amount healed by your Holy Light, Flash of Light, and Holy Shock spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Spiritual Focus
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives your Flash of Light, Holy Light, and Light's Vigil spells a $s1% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

entries.name: Improved Seals
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Seals and Judgements by $s1%.

entries.name: Unyielding Faith
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the duration of  Fear and Disorient effects on you by $s1%.

entries.name: Voice of Truth
entries.descriptionTemplate: Grants you immunity to Silence and Interrupt effects.  Lasts $d.

entries.name: Reverence
entries.descriptionTemplate: Allows $s1% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

entries.name: Purifying Power
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of your Cleanse and Purify spells by $m1% and reduces the cooldown of your Exorcism and Holy Wrath spells by $m2%.

entries.name: Infusion of Light
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your Holy Shock and Flash of Light critical hits reduce the cast time of your next Holy Light cast within $437063d by ${$m1/-1000}.1 sec.

entries.name: Illumination
entries.descriptionTemplate: After getting a critical effect from your Flash of Light, Holy Light, Light's Vigil, or Holy Shock heal spell you have a $m1% chance to gain Mana equal to $m3% of the base cost of the spell.

entries.name: Divine Favor
entries.descriptionTemplate: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a $s1% critical effect chance.

entries.name: Divine Precision
entries.descriptionTemplate: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Holy Shock
entries.descriptionTemplate: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing $1311604s1 Holy damage to an enemy, or $1311605s1 healing to an ally.

entries.name: Consecrated Ground
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives your Holy spells $m1% increased damage against the first $20924s3 enemies that enter your Consecration.

entries.name: Holy Power
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Holy Shock and Holy Strike spells by $m2%, and all other spells by $m1%.

entries.name: Light's Vigil
entries.descriptionTemplate: Applies Light's Vigil to the target for $1310909d. Your next Holy Shock cast on them triggers no cooldown and causes enemy targets to suffer $1310914s1 Holy damage and refund $s2% of Light's Vigil's Mana cost, or allied targets to heal their party for $1310912s1.  The Paladin may only have one Light's Vigil active per party.

entries.name: Toughness
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your armor value from items by $s1%.

entries.name: Redoubt
entries.descriptionTemplate: Damaging melee attacks against you have a $h% chance to increase your chance to block by $m1%.  Lasts $20128d or $20128n blocks.

entries.name: Precision
entries.descriptionTemplate: Improves your chance to hit by $s1%.

entries.name: Guardian's Favor
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Blessing of Protection by $/60000;s1 min and increases the duration of your Blessing of Freedom by $/1000;s2 sec.

entries.name: Anticipation
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your Defense Skill by $m1.

entries.name: Improved Seal of Fury
entries.descriptionTemplate: When Seal of Fury's shield is fully absorbed, restore $m1 Mana, increased by $m2% per level the attacker is above you, up to ${$m2*$m3}%.

entries.name: Improved Righteous Fury
entries.descriptionTemplate: While Righteous Fury is active, all damage taken is reduced by $m1%.

entries.name: Shield Specialization
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your shield by $m1%, and gives your blocks a $m2% chance to restore $1310925m1% of your maximum Mana.  May only occur once every $proccooldown sec.

entries.name: Sacred Duty
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your total Stamina by $s1% and reduces the cooldown of your Divine Shield, Divine Protection, and Templar's Bulwark spells by ${$m2/-1000} sec.

entries.name: Swift Judgement
entries.descriptionTemplate: Finishes the remaining cooldown on your Judgement ability and reduces the Mana cost of your next Judgement by $s1%.

entries.name: One-Handed Weapon Specialization
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage you deal with one-handed melee weapons by $s1%.

entries.name: Improved Hammer of Justice
entries.descriptionTemplate: Decreases the cooldown of your Hammer of Justice spell by $/1000;s1 sec.

entries.name: Templar's Bulwark
entries.descriptionTemplate: When activated, this ability grants you an absorb shield equal to $s1% of your maximum health for $d.  Applies Forbearance for $25771d. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

entries.name: Reckoning
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives you a $m1% chance to gain an extra attack after Blocking a melee attack and a ${$m1*2.5}% chance to gain an extra attack after being the victim of a non-periodic critical strike.

entries.name: Iron Creed
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the threat generated by your Holy Strike ability $m1%. While Righteous Fury is active, Holy Strike also reduces your damage taken by $m2% for $1311033d.

entries.name: Holy Shield
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases chance to block by $s1% for $d, and deals $s2 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active.  Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. $n charges.

entries.name: Deflection
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your Parry chance by $s1%.

entries.name: Benediction
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the Mana cost of all instant cast spells and abilities by $m1%.

entries.name: Improved Judgement
entries.descriptionTemplate: Decreases the cooldown of your Judgement ability by $/1000;s1 sec.

entries.name: Holy Conduit
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of your Consecration, Holy Wrath, Exorcism, and Hammer of Wrath spells by $m1%.

entries.name: Conviction
entries.descriptionTemplate: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by $s1%.

entries.name: Vindication
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives your damaging melee attacks a chance to reduce the target's Attack Power by ${$m1/-3*$440667m1}, and increase your Attack Power by $m1% for $440667d.

entries.name: Sanctified Judgement
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives your Judgement ability a $m1% chance to return $m2% of the Mana cost of the judged seal.

entries.name: Seal of Command
entries.descriptionTemplate:
Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to $20424s1% of normal weapon damage.  Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.  Lasts $d.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing $/2;20467s1 Holy damage, $20467s1 if the target is stunned or incapacitated.

entries.name: Pursuit of Justice
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases movement speed and mounted movement speed by $s1%.  This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

entries.name: Eye for an Eye
entries.descriptionTemplate: All critical strikes against you cause $s1% of the damage taken to the attacker as well. The damage caused by Eye for an Eye will not exceed 50% of the Paladin's total health.

entries.name: Sacred Arbiter
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage of your Holy Strike ability by $m1% and causes it to refresh all Judgement effects on the target.

entries.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by $s1%.

entries.name: Vengeance
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your Physical and Holy damage dealt by $s1% for $20050d after landing a non-periodic critical strike.  Stacks up to $20050u times.

entries.name: Repentance
entries.descriptionTemplate: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to $d. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only works against Humanoids.

entries.name: Champion of the Light
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your spell damage and healing by up to $m1% of your Intellect.

entries.name: Instrument of Law
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cast time of your Hammer of Wrath by ${$m1/-1000}.1 sec, and reduces all threat you generate by $m2% while Righteous Fury is not active.

entries.name: Twist of Light
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the Mana cost of your Seal spells by $s1%, and when you replace your Seal of Command, Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Fury, or Seal of Justice with a different Seal, gain an Echo of that Seal. Your next melee attack applies the replaced Seal's effects, consuming the Echo.
